title: Result Clauses with sodass / so ... dass
summary: Expressing cause-result relationships with stronger sentence linking.
whyItMatters: 'Sodass' expresses a consequence; 'so ... dass' highlights the degree or manner that produces it.

mentalModel.title: Cause first, result second
mentalModel.content: The main clause creates the condition; the sodass-clause states its consequence.

mentalModel.title: So points to intensity
mentalModel.content: Place 'so' with the adjective or adverb when degree is central.

ruleBlocks.title: Use sodass for a general result
ruleBlocks.content: The subordinate clause has verb-final order.

ruleBlocks.title: Use so ... dass for degree-result
ruleBlocks.content: Place 'so' before the quality in the main clause.

ruleBlocks.title: Do not confuse result and purpose
ruleBlocks.content: Use sodass for what happens, damit for what is intended.

tables.title: Result-Clause Patterns
rows: Die Suppe kocht, sodass Wasser verdampft.
Die Soße ist so scharf, dass ich Wasser brauche.
Er schnitt so schnell, dass die Stücke ungleich wurden.

examples.de: Das Gemüse wird klein geschnitten, sodass es schneller gart.
examples.en: The vegetables are cut small so that they cook faster.

examples.de: Der Teig ist so weich, dass er am Löffel klebt.
examples.en: The dough is so soft that it sticks to the spoon.

examples.de: Sie würzte vorsichtig, sodass der Geschmack ausgewogen blieb.
examples.en: She seasoned carefully, so the flavor remained balanced.

commonMistakes.wrong: Use sodass for an intended goal.
Die Suppe ist so heiß, sodass ...
commonMistakes.correct: Die Suppe ist so heiß, dass ...
commonMistakes.reason: The paired degree pattern is so ... dass.

comparisons.summary: Cooking processes provide visible causes and results.
Result clauses explain how preparation affects taste and texture.
